FITLOG
WORKOUT PLANNING
03
01 / OVERVIEW

Workout planning application

FitLog keeps workout planning focused. Each exercise has its own details page with equipment, difficulty, sets, reps and instructions. Visitors can create a daily plan, bookmark exercises, mark work as done and return without losing their saved selections.

TECHNOLOGY STACK
Next.jsTypeScriptTailwind CSSReact ContextlocalStorageLucide
02 / FEATURESWHAT THE APPLICATION DOES

Features

01

Explore a library of twelve exercises and dedicated workout details.

02

Build a daily plan with up to five lifts.

03

Save exercises for later and sort by duration, calories or rating.

04

Track planned exercises, time and calories, with saved local state.

03 / DEVELOPMENTIMPLEMENTATION DETAILS

Challenges & decisions

01

One plan, several views

The workout library, saved list, navbar and daily metrics share changing state. React Context connects these views so additions and removals stay consistent.

02

Persistence in the browser

Plans and bookmarks survive reloads through localStorage. The project combines local persistence with a client-side interface built on Next.js.

03

Small, clear constraints

A daily plan allows up to five exercises. Buttons enforce the limit and toast messages explain actions, while sorting and live totals help visitors understand their plan.

04 / FUTURE DEVELOPMENT

Possible
next steps

Ideas for a future version of the application.

  • Explore a workout-history view and progress charts.
  • Add custom exercises and editable training plans.
  • Consider optional account-based sync between devices.
